post.description:
Return a list of all rows from the Budget Detail Report for a Project and Budget View.

Note:
In addition to all the fields outlined in the response example, there will be an additional key for each visible,
non-formula, non-qualitative column (Ex: Original Budget Amount, Budget Modifications, Forecast to Complete, and Source Columns).

The integer keys returned represent the IDs of the budget columns which are returned by the Budget Detail Columns API.

As well, valid filter values can be found through the Budget Detail Filter Options API.

filters.title: Budget Detail Filter Options
filters.description: Optional filters restricting which budget detail rows are returned. Each key corresponds to a filterable column; valid values are obtained from the List Budget Detail Filter Options API.

biller.description: Filter rows by biller (Project or Sub Job). Each entry targets a Project or Sub Job by id and type.

value.description: IDs of the Projects or Sub Jobs to filter by

type.description: Whether the value identifies a Project or a Sub Job.

name.description: Display name of the Project or Sub Job

cost_code.description: Filter rows by Cost Code id.

root_cost_code.description: Filter rows by Division (root cost code) id.

cost_type.description: Filter rows by Cost Type id.

detail_type.description: Filter rows by detail type value.

items.description: A single row of the Budget Detail Report. In addition to the fields below, the response includes one extra key per visible, non-formula, non-qualitative budget column, keyed by the column's id (see the List Budget Detail Columns API).

biller.description: The Project or Sub Job (biller) the row is attributed to. Filter by passing its id under filters.biller in the List Budget Details request.

contract.description: The contract associated with the row, when the source is a contract.

cost_code.description: The Cost Code for the row. Filter by passing its id under filters.cost_code in the List Budget Details request.

cost_type.description: The Cost Type (line item type) for the row. Filter by passing its id under filters.cost_type in the List Budget Details request.

description.description: Free-text description of the underlying source record for the row. Null when the source has no description.

detail_type.description: The type of source record the row represents (e.g. a commitment contract, direct cost, or forecast item). Filter by passing the id under filters.detail_type in the List Budget Details request.

id.description: Unique identifier of the budget detail row, formed from the source record type and its id (e.g. "budget_line_items-12345").

item.description: Human-readable reference to the underlying source record (e.g. an invoice or contract line). Null when there is no associated item.

link.description: Web app URL where the source record for this row can be viewed. Null when the source has no linkable location.

root_cost_code.description: The Division (root cost code) of the row's cost code. Filter by passing its id under filters.root_cost_code in the List Budget Details request.

vendor.description: The Vendor for the row. Filter by passing its id under filters.vendor in the List Budget Details request.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"filters\":{\"biller\":[{\"value\":[56],\"type\":\"SubJob\",\"name\":\"North Building\"}],\"cost_code\":[1],\"root_cost_code\":[1],\"cost_type\":[1],\"vendor\":[1],\"detail_type\":[\"original_budget_amount\"]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/budget_views/%7Bbudget_view_id%7D/budget_details?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
